Behind The Content

A storyteller who turns everyday moments into content that connects.

I'm Lilis Badriyah — a Jakarta-based content creator and digital storyteller. Over the past five years I've helped brands and audiences find each other through honest, visually-led content: lifestyle features, product storytelling, and campaign videos built to actually get watched. My work sits at the intersection of editorial craft and platform-native creativity, which means every project is shaped around how people really scroll, watch, and share.
